links.comparator_used: Customised GPT with static domain knowledge (GPTs)
links.outcome: Agreement with expert benchmark for systemic therapy recommendations
links.effect: RAG and GPTs both 70.0% agreement vs expert benchmark 63.8%; both met the -10% non-inferiority margin but not the -5% threshold. RAG tended to propose fewer additional tests and lower costs.
links.quote: RAG and GPTs achieved 70.0% agreement versus the expert benchmark (63.8%), meeting the exploratory -10% non-inferiority margin but not the stricter -5% threshold.

design_hint: retrieval augmentation and domain-knowledge customization of an existing GPT
